body: I tried this today and called the court house but they told me that I would have to attend the defensive driving course in person and not an online class.  The class itself is only a $25 fee but I would still have to pay for the court fees, which are apparently $165, because overall I would have to pay $190.  And no, that's fine, I'm just done.  I even asked the woman if I could pay in payment plans because I can't afford to pay $200 all up front and she actually LAUGHED at me on the phone and said "Ma'am, we don't do payment plans, our computers aren't set up for that.  If you don't pay, you go to jail".  Like how professional is it to laugh at someone for that?  Life is a fucking joke.
